decision.reason: The binary-topology fixture encoded historical opcode literals 14 and 18 for plus and percent. The generated grammar authority assigns token IDs 15 and 19, while the emitted Typed IR retained the exact expected plus-over-percent operand topology. The stale predicate therefore reported found=false even though compilation, LLVM closure, execution, and unresolved-member checks were otherwise clean. The fixture now imports syntax.generated.slg and uses tokenIdPlus() and tokenIdPercent() instead of duplicating opcode values. Normalize retained historical verification observations to the existing record contract. Original JSON and terminal outputs remain preserved unchanged. Recorded baseline timeout/cancellation and orphan evidence is retained, not relabeled as current success. No current input compatibility, whole-goal acceptance, new test execution or speed claim.
